Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.
We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.
Do you dream of more elegant and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? You have to ask yourself...do you feel like making an impact?
In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in four key areas:
Human Centered
You’ll lead sourcing and synthesis of customer discovery efforts to understand customer needs to drive the long term vision for your product
You’ll turn these customer insights into actionable strategies that will define the priorities for your team and rally your stakeholders to your vision
Business Focused
You’ll own and prioritize the long-term (12-18 months) product roadmap to deliver on business outcomes, working closely with a cross-functional team to ensure that all the right resources are aligned to ensure that and your team will be successful
You’ll define KPIs for your product and will be responsible for measuring and tracking to those measures, with an eye to adjusting and refining your roadmap as the data dictates
Technology Driven
You’ll have an end-to-end understanding of your product and how it fits into the larger ecosystem to be able to anticipate impacts from changes in other parts of the business
You’ll work closely with tech leadership and architecture to understand the tradeoffs of technical decisions and how they impact the ultimately customer experience your team will deliver always looking to ensure you’re using the best tool for the job
Transformational Leadership
You’ll rally your teams and senior stakeholders to your product vision and proactively leverage relationships throughout the ecosystem to align to your vision and influence prioritization across partner teams You’ll be responsible for attracting and retaining top talent to your team and mentoring and developing associates on their product career
The Behavioral Data Group is the fountain of the data lifecycle here at Capital One producing over 3 billion data records per day and managing the user behavior data collection (think clickstream), enrichment of this data, and delivery to downstream destinations for all applications at Capital One as well as the governance for the sharing of this data with external third parties. We support users throughout the business performing tasks in Marketing, Risk Management, Fraud, Identity Resolution, Personalization, and Product Analytics and Optimization.
In your role, you will be responsible for:
Continued success of the clickstream data as well as the future of the data pipeline and infrastructure.
This entails working with the varied end-users within Capital One to understand their needs of this data and how value is delivered in the appropriate timeframes, alongside partnering with your tech counterparts to ensure the design and development of these features in a timely manner.
Drive our data governance and sharing work stream with a focus on how we safely integrate, use, and share necessary information with partners while ensuring that our customers' data are protected.
This includes oversight of our governance process, onboarding, data scrubbing, and data share management as well as a strategic view of how Capital One automates this governance and reporting.
We want you if you are:
Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.
Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Our team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You always can rally associates to work with you.
Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work.
Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs.
Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help.
Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships.
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
At least 5 years of experience in digital product management
Preferred Qualifications:
MBA or Master’s degree
At least 3 years of experience in Agile product management
Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

Position Description
Faculty Position (Research): Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Reproductive Sciences, UCSF
The Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Reproductive Sciences is seeking a full-time faculty member with a primary interest in establishing and/or growing a robust research program in a department with a dynamic and diverse research portfolio. We strongly encourage applicants from historically excluded groups or those underrepresented in research and medicine to apply.
The faculty may focus on any area of research that falls within the broad research scope of the Department to improve the health and well-being of women, transgender and gender nonbinary people, and people with the capacity for pregnancy in the United Status and globally. Faculty may choose to pursue an area of research that is aligned or in collaboration with current research activities within the Department or develop new areas and programs that are not addressed within our current research portfolio. The Department currently has a particular focus on research in sexual and reproductive health including contraception and abortion, environmental health and justice, health disparities, health equity, preterm birth, Black maternal health, uterine fibroids, and cancer screening and prevention. The faculty member’s research program must fall broadly within quantitative or qualitative methodologic approaches related to human subjects research including but not limited to clinical, environmental health related sciences (e.g. epidemiology, exposure science), social science, implementation science, health services, public health, behavioral, or community-based participatory research, or epidemiology.
The candidate will be appointed at the Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor in the Adjunct or In-Residence series depending on qualifications and interests. Faculty will be primarily affiliated with one or more of the following Department divisions or research units: Advancing New Standards in Reproductive Health (ANSIRH), Bixby Center for Global Reproductive Health, Division of Maternal Fetal Medicine, Division of Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Gynecologic Subspecialities, the California Preterm Birth Initiative (PTBi), the Program on Reproductive Health and the Environment or the Environmental Research and Translation for Health (EaRTH) Center.
This faculty position will include significant initial salary support for research and academic time over 5 years, as well as funds for research activities (e.g., research staff and equipment), with the amount of support based upon the successful candidate’s existing grant funding and rank. Conduct clinical in-use studies to guide dose solution administration.
Interpret results and draw conclusions from multistage experiments; note significant deviations and propose relevant new experiments.
Generate high-quality data based on sound scientific principles and prepare formulation data summaries, technical reports, and scientific presentations.
Support functional technical initiatives by investigating and developing novel experimental approaches and/or technologies in the field of drug product development.
Maintain oversight of day-to-day laboratory activities; manage inventory of raw materials and drug product packaging and manufacturing supplies; coordinate ordering, shipping, and receiving.

Position will be hired commensurate with experience.

job_title: Senior Manager, Product Software Engineering – Autonomous Vehicles
full_description:
NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Software Engineering Manager to lead the end-to-end development of our autonomous vehicle software product.
Autonomous vehicles are transforming the way we live, work, and play—creating safer and more efficient roads.Tapping into decades-long experience in high-performance computing, imaging, and AI, NVIDIA has built a software-defined end-to-end platform for the transportation industry that enables continuous improvement and deployment through over-the-air updates. It delivers everything needed to develop autonomous vehicles at scale. If you are passionate about autonomous driving and vehicles, we would love to hear from you!
What You Will Be Doing
Leading and growing an organization of engineers and managers in the Autonomous Vehicle Product Software team. You will manage a team responsible for:
Codebase health: Maintaining codebase health (from the perspective of driving quality) by ensuring accurate test coverage (test set management) and introducing/ensuring other engineering best practices.
Release stabilization: Working with the release management & other AV dev teams to stabilize upcoming releases and ensure that they are at a sufficient quality level for customer deliverables.
Integrations & migrations: Collaborating with the product & other AV dev teams on the roll-out of major new features/components, migrations, etc. Ensuring that any negative trade-offs on driving quality are minimized and/or acceptable.
In-car testing: Owning the in-car development testing service for new features, partnering with the Operations teams on the drive scaling strategy & execution, and ensuring that accurate and meaningful results are produced for developers (e.g. on-road failures are translated to clean replay tests).
KPIs & analytics: Implementing, reporting, and analyzing E2E product KPIs to understand the current state of our software and inform product priorities.
Diagnostics & triage: Participating in the diagnostics & triage of high priority issues to the corresponding team; over time, leading the standardization and scaling portions of this activity to Ops.
Workflow & tooling: Rapidly prototyping solutions to unblock execution and working with the relevant tooling/ops teams to productionize them in a manner that is consistent with the broader process/ecosystem.
Flex team: Leading or executing high priority activities with no clear owner, e.g. driving cross-functional issues to resolution, rapidly prototyping solutions to unblocking execution.
What We Need To See
BS, MS, or higher degree, in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science or equivalent experience.
12+ years of overall experience in a similar or related role, with 3+ years managing a software engineering team.
Prior experience managing managers in a fast-paced environment, delivering complex software products.
Well-rounded knowledge of how an autonomous vehicle stack works, and practical experience dealing with the challenges in this area.
Strong leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to drive consensus and alignment across large organizations.
Solid C/C++ programming skills, experience working in Linux, using version control systems, and debugging.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd
Background with autonomous vehicle and/or machine learning development.
Experience with data analysis tools/languages such as SQL.
Prior experience working in a fast-paced, start-up or early-stage product environment.
The base salary range is 268,000 USD - 414,000 USD. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

full_description:
What To Expect
Have you dedicated years to developing a world class skillset as a product designer and are motivated by the idea of your next big challenge? Does getting to work in the clean energy space and using your talents to help impact climate change light you up? If so, we’re excited to talk with you.
In this role, you’ll lead mobile app design for users of Tesla energy products such as solar and Powerwall. The vision is that with thoughtful human centered design approaches, we can make sustainable energy products and concepts more accessible to more customers, helping pave the way to mass adoption and changing the world with good design.
You’ll be in at the early stage of a dynamic and rapidly growing team and get to help shape the overall direction of our products, processes and culture. You’ll embed yourself in our deeply collaborative cross-functional environment. You’ll engage in (and lead) regular ideation sessions with forward-thinking engineering and product partners, and other designers throughout Tesla. You’ll constantly push boundaries to shape new experiences in new ways, leveraging immersive 3D storytelling, engaging interaction design, and pixel perfect UI. You’ll regularly and rapidly ship features that will appeal to both non-technical users, and the Tesla die-hards who have followed us for years and pay close attention to every pixel. Most importantly, you’ll be dedicating your skills to a historic mission, along with likeminded colleagues who care deeply about the planet and have dedicated their careers to helping protect it, and be challenged in ways that will push you to do your best work.
What You'll Do
Creating comprehensive feature specs in Figma that both demonstrate your ability to derive unique and innovative design patterns while also leveraging (and when applicable contributing to) the Tesla design system
Using both in person interviews and analytics to gauge the effects of your work and continually finding ways to ship more effective solutions and iterations on past work
Finding unrecognized opportunities that aren’t on the roadmap and helping to get them prioritized through building trust and positive relationships with our product and engineering partners
Being a confident and effective communicator and collaborator to develop great relationships with designers in other Tesla orgs to make sure we are all working towards a unified and consistent experience for all of our customers
Being a storyteller who thinks about the big picture–able to zoom into pixel level detail and zoom all the way out to understand how all the pieces fit together, including pieces other colleagues are working on
Being able to quickly understand complex topics you are unfamiliar with and translate that understanding into creative and intuitive solutions
What You'll Bring
Portfolio samples that demonstrate an ability to turn technically complex problems into elegant and empathetic solutions that reduce cognitive load on end users
4+ years of working on designing digital products, services and experiences from ideation to implementation
Fluency in Figma including working with and contributing to design systems
Demonstrated experience in building, prototyping and continually evolving mobile app experiences
Ability to create beautiful and creative UI solutions and have strong opinions about what constitutes good design
Ability to make sense of complex information and distill it into simple user-facing flows
Great presentation skills–you’ll present your own work at all levels of the company and be expected to speak to your process and approach while being an advocate for good design process
Hands-on experience in planning and conducting user research, usability testing, A/B testing, rapid prototyping, heuristic analysis, and identifying accessibility concerns
Hunger and passion to find opportunities to help the business beyond just those you’re asked to work on
A growth mindset and openness to receiving and integrating feedback and constructive criticism
Prior experience working on UX for connected hardware solutions with a large customer base is a plus

Aetna PPO and HSA plans > 2 medical plan options with $0 payroll deduction

full_description:
Description
The Principal Finance Manager – Production Finance will be lead for Amazon Studios Original Movies portfolio within our fast growing global studio production business. The portfolio of projects included will span across multiple genres and geographies with a team to support. This is an exciting opportunity to join the team at a high growth stage and have ownership of production accounting and production finance functions. The successful candidate will assist in the identification, creation, development, and integration of innovative solutions, internal controls, and financial reporting processes. The individual will also be charged with overseeing the month-end financial reporting process, technical accounting research and documentation, and account reconciliation review for his/ her portfolio of shows. This position will work closely with studios finance, production and creative executives to manage a large portfolio of original productions with sizable budgets and scale.
This role will oversee all facets of the production finance operation and accounting process for his/ her portfolio of shows: from production accounting team management to ensuring timely and accurate reporting of actual and estimated show costs, through final tax credit submissions and show closure. You will be part of a dynamic and creative Production Finance team working directly with our production business units.
This role will collaborate closely with the physical production team on budgets and analyses and is responsible for protecting company assets through cash management and ongoing monitoring of adherence to policies and procedures. The successful candidate will exhibit cross-functional dynamic collaboration with all business partners to provide shows with accurate and timely production finance support towards the end goal of producing great content.
The candidate must operate successfully in a fast-paced, global, results-oriented environment, and have the ability to influence the decisions of senior business leaders through effective verbal and written communication, logical reasoning, the presentation of alternatives and recommendations. The successful candidate must be able to think and act both strategically and tactically. Strong oral and written communication skills are crucial, as well as the ability to analyze quantitatively, problem-solve, and prioritize.
The role requires a seasoned leader and business partner who is a self-starter and able to work autonomously as well as cross-functionally with internal teams including Production, Creative Development, Business Affairs, Legal, Finance, and Accounting. The ideal candidate will understand the television original production business and be able to liaise between the Amazon business teams and production personnel.
This position will lead a team of 5+ people and will continue to build out the team as we grow and scale.
Key Responsibilities
Manage team of production finance executives responsible for hiring and managing production accounting teams, reviewing production budgets and cost reports, and overseeing multi-currency project funding for our productions
Work with production accountants and production managers to drive accurate, complete, and timely cost reporting, protecting and managing show assets and supporting production
Partner with Production, Business Affairs, Legal, Tax, Finance, and Accounting to ensure accurate reporting of estimated final costs
Ensure that the Amazon Studios production accounting policies and procedures are uniformly implemented, are in accordance with standards established by Amazons, and are in compliance with collective bargaining agreements and state and local tax regulations
Develop and improve financial reporting processes, controls, and policies
Manage external relationships with production service companies and preferred vendors
Create and drive innovative solutions that will enable the finance org to maintain effective controllership in a high growth business
Liaise with Production Audit, Tax, Accounting, and Legal to ensure production finance policies and procedures are current and effectively implemented
Adopt new technologies and determine how best to incorporate into production accounting workflow
Identify and address problems quickly including breakdowns in communication
Stay abreast of current and changing industry trends, evolving technologies, and production incentives
Travel to production locations where our shows are filming to review workflows, organizational abilities, and effectiveness of accounting staff
This role will be based in Beverly Hills, California
We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:
Beverly Hills, CA, USA
Basic Qualifications
12+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
7+ years of finance technology, forecast & budgeting, or other finance-focused competency experience
Experience with Tableau, Python, SQB, Quicksight, Cognos or or other BI packages
10+ years Experience as a Production Finance Executive or Production Accountant
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a leadership position managing finance, accounting and operational processes

201 Third Street (61049), United States of America, San Francisco, California
Senior Lead Engineer - Generative AI Product Engineering (Remote-Eligible)
Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities, to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.
We are looking for an experienced Sr. Lead Engineer to help build and maintain APIs and SDKs to train, fine-tune and access AI models at scale. You will work as part of our Enterprise AI team and build systems that will enable our users to work with Large-Language Models (LLMs) and Foundation Models (FMs), using our public cloud infrastructure. You will work with a team of world-class AI engineers and researchers to design and implement key API products and services of our capabilities and enable real-time customer-facing applications powered by these capabilities. Examples of projects you will work on include:
Architect, build and deploy well-managed core APIs and SDKs to access LLMs and our proprietary FMs including training, fine-tuning and prompting tasks, including orchestration SDKs.
Design APIs for performance, real-time applications, scale, ease of use and governance automation.
Develop application-specific interfaces that leverage LLMs and FMs to continue to enhance the associate and customer experience..
Enable our users to build new AI capabilities
Develop tools and processes to monitor API access patterns and operational health.
Design and implement AI safety and guardrails in the API layer working closely with researchers.
Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a technical field.
At least 8 years of experience designing and building data-intensive solutions using distributed computing and cache optimization techniques.
At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java
At least 3 years of experience building, scaling, and optimizing training and inferencing APIs for deep neural networks
Preferred Qualifications:
Familiarity with building large-scale AI products or platforms for NLP, speech, computer vision, or recommendation systems serving millions of users.
Ability to move fast in an environment with ambiguity at times, and with competing priorities and deadlines. Experience at tech and product-driven companies/startups preferred.
Ability to iterate rapidly with researchers and engineers to improve a product experience while building the foundational capabilities
Familiarity with deploying large neural network models in demanding production environments.
Have experience with API security, observability, cloud access control and privacy best practices.

full_description:

Company Name: Capital One
Job Description
Center 1 (19052), United States of America, McLean, Virginia
Lead Engineer - Generative AI Product Engineering (Remote-Eligible)
Our mission at Capital One is to create trustworthy, reliable and human-in-the-loop AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. Because of our investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms, we are now uniquely positioned to harness the power of AI. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.
We are looking for an experienced Lead Generative AI Engineer to help build and maintain APIs and SDKs to train, fine-tune and access AI models at scale. You will work as part of our Enterprise AI team and build systems that will enable our users to work with Large-Language Models (LLMs) and Foundation Models (FMs), using our public cloud infrastructure. You will work with a team of world-class AI engineers and researchers to design and implement key API products and services that enable real-time customer-facing applications.
Examples of projects you will work on include:
Architect, build and deploy well-managed core APIs and SDKs to access LLMs and our proprietary FMs including training, fine-tuning and prompting tasks, including orchestration SDKs.
Design APIs for performance, real-time applications, scale, ease of use and governance automation.
Develop application-specific interfaces that leverage LLMs and FMs to continue to enhance the associate and customer experience.
Enable our users to build new GenAI capabilities.
Develop tools and processes to monitor API access patterns and operational health.
Design and implement AI safety and guardrails in the API layer working closely with researchers.
Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a technical field
At least 6 years of experience designing and building data-intensive solutions using distributed computing and cache optimization techniques
At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java
At least 2 years of experience building, scaling, and optimizing training and inferencing APIs for deep neural networks
Preferred Qualifications:
Familiarity with building large-scale AI products or platforms for NLP, speech, computer vision, or recommendation systems serving millions of users.
Ability to move fast in an environment with ambiguity at times, and with competing priorities and deadlines. Experience at tech and product-driven companies/startups preferred.
Ability to iterate rapidly with researchers and engineers to improve a product experience while building the foundational capabilities.
Familiarity with deploying large neural network models in demanding production environments.
Have experience with API security, observability, cloud access control and privacy best practices.

Medical Distribution Product Management is responsible for identifying, recommending, designing, and implementing new solutions for the Medical and Surgical Product Distribution including new distribution models, practices, processes, metrics, and technology features.
Medical Distribution Strategic Marketing and Product Management team
leads strategic planning, develop strategic vision and roadmap, and build the business case and financials models for growth initiatives and product innovation. The team leverages strategic marketing framework to support marketing strategy and implementation plan and staging gate process to manage product development and commercialization.

full_description:
About Gap
Gap has always been about optimistic American style. Starting with our very first store on Ocean Avenue in San Francisco, opened almost 50 years ago by Doris and Don Fisher. The thread that’s run through those five decades is the phenomenal people that make up our brand – our employees and our customers. People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.
We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.
About The Role
In this role, you will support the store leadership team by performing functional tasks as assigned. You will act as a mentor and role model to employees to support service behaviors and the execution of tasks in specific areas of expertise. You will focus on leading processes and/or areas of the business, executing tasks and maintaining productivity to ensure goals are met. The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.
Mission Overview & Responsibilities
New York Times Wirecutter is looking for a Senior Product Designer to lead the design of new and existing editorial tools to produce our recommendations.
We aim for the quality of our publishing tools to match the expertise and empower the goals of New York Times Wirecutter editors and our production organization. We are building a new content management system (CMS) that will be the foundation of all of our recommendation content for years to come. As the primary designer for this suite of tools, you’ll improve workflows, unlock new formats and capabilities, and help editors publish trusted reviews and recommendations.
Your Role
As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll work as an individual contributor with Product, Engineering, and Editorial partners to work towards the vision of Wirecutter’s new CMS which will be integrated into the New York Times platform, Scoop. You'll learn the review lifecycle, master editorial and production workflows, work with requirements to create designs, test low-fidelity flows with editors and producers, and collaborate with engineering partners to ship a quality MVP.
If you enjoy iterating toward a larger vision, rendering complex interactions simply, quickly validating ideas, and thoughtfully applying and extending design systems, this is the role for you.
You will report to Wirecutter’s Product Design Director. We are open to remote candidates.
Responsibilities
You will collaborate on high-level product strategy, identifying distinct needs and guiding the right questions.
You will create documentation (e.g. user journeys, experience maps, wireframes, frameworks) to guide discussions and facilitate the decision process.
You will collaborate with engineers and product teams to develop and refine requirements for multiple product ideas.
You will conduct informal testing with editors, incorporate insights into designs, and produce production-ready deliverables using design patterns while ensuring design quality throughout the development process.
You will participate in team and product design rituals, nurturing the design team by inspiring and mentoring teammates and enhancing our processes and documentation.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of experience designing digital products—especially on the web—with product and engineering collaborators.
1+ years of recent experience leading complex design efforts related to publishing/internal tools or tools with heavy user-facing controls.
A portfolio of work that showcases your design process along with finished design work.
Preferred Qualifications
Demonstrated expertise in solving for complex states, iterating on designs based on usage patterns and user feedback, and adapting to the evolving competitive landscape.
Experience making on-brand visual choices that enhance informational clarity, guide user behavior, and follow brand, platform, and interaction conventions.
Experience facilitating workshops and brainstorms with cross-functional collaborators.
Advanced proficiency in Figma (including its prototyping functionality) or comparable tools.
Demonstrated understanding of modern HTML & CSS and a grasp of current development philosophies/methodologies for building consumer products.

full_description:
What To Expect
The Drive Systems team is looking for a Sr. or Staff product expert for long term ownership of the Tesla Semi Drive Axle. This role will own and maintain the assembly definitions including CAD, drawings, and all relevant product and manufacturing specifications, and will also oversee long-term change management and improvement efforts of the drive axle product.
Tesla is currently ramping high-volume production of the Semi Truck at Gigafactory Nevada, a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of the transition to electric commercial vehicles. The Semi requires an uncompromising standard for design reliability and efficiency and includes cutting edge innovations across the powertrain. The product engineer is a multidisciplined and fundamentals driven role that will bring deep and wide systems thinking including working knowledge of high-volume automation, structural casting, geartrain design, and motors or mechatronic systems to successfully own and improve the highly integrated axle. The product engineer will rely on an extensive background in integration and program development to own the design, change management process, and direct coordination of improvement efforts across a large set of stakeholders.
What You'll Do
Own the Semi Drive Axle assemblies including CAD, 2D drawings, and technical specifications and manage component and axle level integration
Drive design maturity and high-volume requirements through production launch and ramp, and manage ongoing improvement efforts across the product
Own change management, version tracking, and detailed requirements and release checklists
Work in depth with component and system owners to generate engineering outputs and drive rigorous requirement documentation and launch diligence
Own communication across the design, manufacturing, operations, and reliability teams
Drive adoption of new systems, features, and best practices by engineering teams to improve productivity and provide ongoing support as a central authority on these items
What You'll Bring
Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent
Minimum 6 years’ experience with development of complex mechanical products
Minimum 6 years’ experience with Computer Aided Design including part, assembly, and drawing development and product lifecycle management
Extensive background in high precision mechanical product design, industrial powertrain design, or similar field
Proactive, highly organized, and detail oriented, with strong technical communication ability to drive product and process improvements with a large interdisciplinary engineering team

full_description:
Position Title
Embryology Lab Manager - Reproductive Medicine Clinic
Department
OUHP Reproductive Medicine Clinic
Job Description
General Description:
The Reproductive Laboratories Manager (RLM) oversees the day-to-day operation of the Andrology/Endocrinology laboratory and the Assisted Reproductive Technology Laboratory. The RLM, under the supervision of the Director of Laboratories, is responsible for the maintenance and modification of the Policy and Procedure Manual as well as other documentation deemed necessary to meet the goals of total quality management of the combined laboratories.
Essential Responsibilities
Responsibilities listed in this section are core to the position. Inability to perform these responsibilities with or without an accommodation may result in disqualification from the position.
Responsible for testing, overseeing quality control and quality assurance and the management of other testing personnel.
Directly supervises the Embryology Staff. and establishes work schedules and is responsible for the training and evaluation of testing personnel.
Works as a bench scientist in the Andrology/Endocrinology laboratory and Assisted Reproductive Technology laboratory
Under the direction of the Director of Laboratories is responsible for maintaining laboratory accreditation under CLIA 88, CAP/SART and the FDA.
The Laboratory Director can authorize/designate the RLM (with TS certification) to perform some tasks related to laboratory quality control and quality assessment which are performed by the Laboratory Director.
Is frequently required to interact with faculty physicians, referring physicians, residents, Fellows and patients, regarding the analysis and interpretation of testing results.
At the direction of the Laboratory Director, or in some cases the Medical Director, takes an active role in meeting the research goals of the Department.
Participates in continuing education in order to maintain and expand his/her skills in the areas of Assisted Reproductive Technology and endocrine and andrology testing as well as maintaining his/her TS certification by ABB.
Some weekend and holiday work is required.
General Responsibilities
Performs other duties as assigned
Minimum Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor’s degree required. Bachelor’s in a biological or physical science preferred
or
a non-science Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 24 hours of course work in the sciences including 12 hours of chemistry (inorganic and organic chemistry) with an additional 12 hours of course work in the biological sciences preferred. A Master’s degree in the Reproductive Sciences is preferred.
Experience:
A minimum of six years of experience in performing andrology and endocrine testing including a minimum of three years of experience working as an Embryologist.
License(s)/Certification(s)/Registration(s)
Required:
Board-certified as a Technical supervisor (TS) by a national accrediting board such as the American Board of Bioanalysis (ABB) required.
Knowledge, Skills And Abilities
Mastery of all of the techniques used in the ART laboratory including embryo culture, micromanipulation techniques, embryo assessment/grading, cryopreservation of embryos and gametes and embryo transfer.
Must have a keen grasp of the application of quality control measures as related to the running of the ART laboratory.
Experience and skill in the use of Excel and Access computer programs regarding the construction and maintenance of data files.
Proven ability to manage a team of professionals and lead a departmental function
Proven ability to effectively manage multiple high priority deliverables
Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills

full_description:

Excellent influencing, communication, and people management skills to lead initiatives with key stakeholders and executive management.
About The Job
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
We are the team that builds Google Tensor, Google’s custom System-on-a-Chip (SoC) that powers Pixel devices. Tensor makes transformative user experiences possible with the help of Machine Learning running on our Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) Machine Learning accelerator. Our goal is to produce the latest Machine Learning innovations and research by delivering heterogeneous computing hardware and software.
As an Executive Product Manager, you will drive their Generative AI goal and strategy for Tensor. You will work with Google Research to bring Machine Learning to on-device.
Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology.

Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Learn more about benefits at Google .

Drive internal stakeholder and partner engagements necessary for the on-time launch of the product features.
Collaborate with marketing, legal, and multiple cross-functional teams for product launches enabled with Google Tensor.

full_description:
EY focuses on high-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. EY Nexus for Advanced Manufacturing & Mobility (N4AM&M) is EY's newest ambition for continued growth in the manufacturing and mobility sectors. Building on the success of our Nexus platform in financial services, N4AM&M is a cloud native, modern technology platform and product play that enables AM&M clients as they launch new business models supporting electrification and the development of smart connected product platforms.
The opportunity
The AM&M Advanced Manufacturing Product Architect leads the technical design for sector products built on the EY Nexus platform, has a deep technical understanding of the EY Nexus platform, and shapes the technology and patterns for products that solve for sector business problems.
Your Key Responsibilities
Leads all product architecture for the sector and ensures alignment to the EY Nexus architecture.
Work with the AM&M Sector Product Leader to successfully deliver sector products from design to production.
Articulates the product's architectural vision and structure and specifies the features that the market requirements prescribe through a Product Requirements Document.
Works with the Chief Architect to provide recommendations to the platform roadmap on new components or enhancements needed for sector products.
Participates in the Architecture Working Group to share and collaborate with other EY Nexus architects.
Work with EY Nexus Pre-sales/Sales teams to pursue and close priority sector deals.
Contribute at least one design/pattern/service to the EY Nexus service catalog.
Skills And Attributes For Success
Develop cohesive, compelling strategic technical visions for our products that support the ambitions of the market and help clients realize their business plans.
Understands the market opportunity, interprets market requirements, and is well-versed in technology and development process.
Strong presentation skills to customers and internal colleagues.
Provide product and platform demonstrations for prospective and current clients.
Evangelize the EY Nexus platform and AM&M products built on the platform both internally and externally through compelling story telling.
Work closely with the technology teams, account leaders and the EY Nexus family.
Communicate strategic visions to our clients and help them and their business development teams socialize the strategy to the greater organization.
Assess client business models and identify new revenue opportunities within the context of brand, market, user, financial, and technology constraints.
Collaborate closely with EY design, architecture, technology and cross-service line teams to ensure business requirements are deeply integrated into the user experience.
Drive pitches and business development activities.
Partner with client services to continue to understand market demands and leverage account insight to enhance the sector products.
To qualify for the role you must have
10 years or more of related work experience.
5+ years of practical market experience in the automotive or manufacturing industries with recent experience applying your skills around the challenges of electrification that include the design, assembly, or market deployment of electric vehicles and related connected infrastructure.
Former experience in product architecture roles is strongly desired.
5+ years of experience in software development and solution architecture, IoT, AI/ML, big data, APIs, cloud, microservices, low/no code applications and disciplines are highly desired.
5+ years in a customer facing capacity with strong presentation skills.
Flexibility to move where the role takes you and adjust to customer and market needs dynamically.
A strong desire to learn and work on progressive and ever-changing technology solutions.
Ideally, you'll also have
Certifications in respective technologies and disciplines are preferred (i.e. AWS/GCP/Azure Solution Architecture).
Experience in technology consulting, solutions architecture, and technical sales for software or cloud-native technology platforms.
What We Look For
We're interested in candidates that can work in a fast growing and ever-changing environment with the flexibility to adapt as the market demands and who possess a deep passion for technology in the manufacturing, automotive, and mobility industries. A strong desire to work with emerging technologies and to help clients achieve their business goals.
What We Offer
We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The salary range for this job in most geographic locations in the US is $163,400 to $373,300. The salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $196,100 to $424,300. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon.

The Sr. Electronics Design Engineer provides expertise to deliver electronic and electrical designs throughout the entire development process. Conceptional design through detail design, prototypes through volume manufacturing, initial integration through qualification. You will collaborate with a multidisciplined project team on the electrical infrastructure, perform engineering analysis, generate detailed electronic designs, create engineering drawings/documents and partner with suppliers. The position requires highly motivated, extremely organized and self-driven individuals.
This position may require access to controlled technology, as defined in the Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Job Summary
The Electrical Design Engineer is responsible for electrical, instrumentation, and controls design development for heavy industry projects. The Electrical Design Engineer provides engineering support for engineering, plant improvement and commissioning projects at industrial facilities such as processing plants, gas compression facilities, mining facilities and other related types of projects. This position focuses on engineering, design, and implementation of electrical instruments, equipment, and systems for heavy industrial plants. Executes completion activities at project sites, and verifies that documentation is completed. The Electrical Design Engineer plays a crucial role in the field of electrical engineering, contributing to the design and development of electrical systems for various applications
Key Responsibilities:
Develop electrical system designs for various projects, ensuring they meet the specified requirements and standards.
Create detailed schematic diagrams, wiring diagrams, and layout drawings using computer-aided design (CAD) tools.
Select appropriate electrical components, such as switches, circuit breakers, transformers, and other devices, based on project requirements and specifications.
Ensure that electrical designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations, including safety standards and environmental requirements.
Interpret and apply applicable codes like ISA 51, ANSI/NEMA, FMR, NFPA, NEC.
Work closely with other engineering disciplines, such as mechanical and civil engineers, as well as with architects and clients, to integrate electrical systems into overall project designs.
Provide input for cost estimation and budgeting related to electrical components and systems.
Prepare and maintain detailed documentation of electrical designs, including drawings, specifications, and technical reports.
Ensure electrical systems meet applicable codes for the project.
Hands on support for commissioning/start-up activities.
Key Competencies:
Demonstrated commitment to safety.
Strong knowledge of electrical engineering principles and practices
Proficiency in CAD software and simulation tools.
Ability to perform short circuit analysis, arc flash studies, power flow studies, relay coordination.
Strong understanding of PLC ladder logic, digital and sequential logic programming methods, and process related closed-loop control systems.
Knowledge of the National Electrical Code.
Knowledge of API codes as applied to electrical installations.
Knowledge of engineering principles, practices and procedures.
Knowledge of automation (PLC / DCS) and electrical system design, diagnosis and operation.
Reads, understands and interprets electrical schematics and drawings.
Ability to analyze and solve complex problems.
Will follow instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the function of the job under minimal supervision
Advanced communication skills, both written and oral.
Demonstrated logical problem solving and analytical skills.
Knowledge of low voltage power distribution, instrumentation and controls engineering.
Work Conditions
Working on-site in heavy industrial environments mostly but not limited to mining and gas industries. These environments may have the following conditions: Extreme temperature conditions, both hot and cold; in and/or around moisture; on slippery and/or uneven surfaces, in confined spaces; and at heights.
Hours of operation and employee schedules vary based on each project and may require irregular or extended hours and travel for project completion.
Up to 80% travel, including both domestic and international travel.
Will require frequent standing, occasional bending, squatting, climbing, twisting, balancing, and reaching.
Will have exposure to noise, vibrations, well-treating chemicals, glycol, methanol, gasoline, natural gas, and liquid hydrocarbons.
Will follow instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the function of the job under general supervision.
Will often work alone with minimum supervision.
Education/Experience:
Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience in related field.
10+ years of experience in the electrical design and engineering.
Must possess a valid driver’s license and have an acceptable driving record.

job_title: SLD Fluids Design Engineer Mid Career– Lunar Permanence
full_description:
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our diverse team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
This role is part of the Lunar Transportation business unit. To further Blue Origin's mission of having millions of people living and working in space, we are building the sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from earth to the Lunar Surface.
We are looking for multiple fluids propulsion and mechanical design engineers. You will design the propulsion and/or fluid systems for Lunar spacecraft. Work will include the complete life cycle of the system from definition, interfaces, conceptual design, detailed design, component development, assembly, verification, and operation. You will own your components from initial design to analyzing data from their landing on the moon!
You will understand and contribute to flight piping and instrumentation diagrams and schematics. You will design and perform 1st order analyses to verify your designs. You will work with suppliers or Blue Origin groups to identify and procure components. You will build Lunar vehicles in CAD by modeling valves, propulsion elements, sensors, piping, and other equipment in the flight vehicle. You will size, select material, and analyze piping and supporting structure for structural integrity due to pressure, vibration, fracture, fatigue, etc. You will manage suppliers and other support to procure, fabricate, and install flight hardware. You will create and manage the project plans for various hardware including cost and schedule. You may mentor entry level engineers and perform technical peer reviews.
Bring your technical expertise, leadership skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!
You will work directly with NASA and our National Team Partners as part of the Human Landing System (HLS) Sustaining Lunar Development (SLD) program. You will play a key role in developing the Lunar Transportation system that will return humans to the Moon and extend human presence permanently beyond the bounds of Earth.
Minimum Qualifcations:
B.S. degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or related field
5+ years of experience in aerospace propulsion and fluid analysis and piping design including process component selection and process fluid design architecture
Knowledge of propulsion and fluid system components (i.e. valves, regulators and pumps for cryogenics, propellants, and other fluids)
Experience performing the structural and fluid design and analysis of piping and tubing systems; and using analysis tools such as ANSYS, Thermal Desktop.
Experience interpreting and generating Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
Experience creating fabrication and installation drawings with ProEngineer/Creo
Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of collaboration and inclusion
Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with ProEngineer/Creo, Windchill, and ProPiping
Knowledge of standard installation and fabrication methods of piping systems (tube stock, fittings, connections, fasteners, welding, etc.)
Advanced Engineering degree
Experience with static and non-linear FEA analysis (ANSYS)
Knowledge of ASME Y14.5 geometric dimensioning and tolerance

full_description:

About Us:
At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.
Job Summary:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Principal Antenna Design Engineer to join our Radome & Apertures team in McKinney, Texas, with responsibilities having significant impact, recognition, and growth in the organization.
The Radome & Apertures team resides within the Apertures and RF Department. The department is responsible for full-scope antenna product solutions, spanning architecture trades, design, development, integration, deployment, and sustainment of antenna systems and associated integrated system verification solutions.
The candidate will support state-of-the-art ultra-wideband phased array antennas, individual antennas, and Low Observable (LO) antennas within the Company. The selected candidate will lead and work with diverse teams of engineers and scientists with backgrounds in Active Electronically Scanned Arrays (AESAs), Computational Electromagnetics Modeling, RF Test, Mechanical, Structural and Thermal analysis, Material Science, Process and Manufacturing Engineering and LO technology.
The ideal candidate for this role will enjoy both theoretical design and hands-on engineering tasks. He / She is an inquisitive problem solver, self-driven, and determined with a positive attitude, has a broad range of antenna design skills, and would enjoy diving deeper into Low Observable antenna research and development. If you are looking for an opportunity to grow with a leader in the Aerospace Industry, this is the perfect opportunity for you! This position requires some job duties to be performed onsite due to the sensitive nature of this work and the desire for in-person collaboration, however we offer flexible in-office hours and the ability to perform some job duties remotely.
We value diverse skills and experience, so don't hold back. Your qualifications could add tremendous value to our team. Our customers come from all different backgrounds, and so do our employees. If you're passionate about what you could accomplish here, we'd love to hear from you.
Responsibilities to Anticipate:
Be responsible for the hands-on design and realization of individual antennas, phased array antennas and passive RF components.
Use computational electromagnetic analysis software to design and predict performance on various types of antennas and apertures (spiral, sinuous, Vivaldi, patch, slot, horn, ultra-wideband tightly coupled dipole arrays, etc.)
Exhibit exceptionally high level of innovation, creativity, and initiative.
Support customer programs through modeling and simulation of antennas or RF components/systems and leading teams that perform these functions.
Provide technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems involving antenna/sensor-based applications such as radar, electronic warfare, electronic attack, electronic support measures, communications, geolocation, direction finding, etc.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external customers. Represent the organization in providing solutions to difficult technical issues associated with specific projects.
Mentor and guide more junior engineers and technicians in the design, build, and test phases of projects and programs.
Work with interdisciplinary engineering teams including thermal, structural, mechanical, systems, etc.
Analyze simulation or test data to verify performance to requirements.
Participate in and guide the testing of RF hardware for required performance metrics: VSWR, insertion loss, gain, polarization, radar cross section (RCS), etc.
Qualifications You Must Have:
Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of experience.
Each higher-level degree, i.e., Master’s Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of experience. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education.
The ability to obtain and maintain a US security clearance prior to the start date. U.S. citizenship is required as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.
Qualifications We Value:
Masters or PhD in Electrical Engineering with a concentration in Electromagnetics.
Experience with design, fabrication, and test of conformal antennas, apertures, and passive RF components (radiating elements, radomes, power dividers, couplers, transitions, multi-layer board designs, Frequency Selective Surfaces (FSSs), etc.).
Full competency in core RF engineering and antenna theory and skills and general knowledge of other related disciplines.
Strong experience leading a team and presenting technical data to stakeholders and customers in design reviews and technical interchange meetings.
Excellent communication skills; both verbal and written. Assist with the preparation and delivery of presentations and proposals.
Implement various design techniques (materials, shaping, etc.) for RCS mitigation where necessary.
Experience with RCS data processing tools, such as Knowbell, Pioneer or Saber
Aerospace industry experience running successful R&D efforts to develop Low Observable RF apertures, components, and technology, including budget, schedule, tasking, and review of technical products.
Proficiency with EM modeling & simulation tools such as HFSS, CST, FEKO or SENTRi.
Ability to obtain Top Secret clearance as well as the ability to obtain special access clearance(s).
What We Offer:
Whether you’re just starting out on your career journey or are an experienced professional, we offer a robust total rewards package that goes above and beyond with compensation; healthcare, wellness, retirement, and work/life benefits; career development and recognition programs. Some of the superior benefits we offer include parental (including paternal) leave, flexible work schedules, achievement awards, educational assistance, and child/adult backup care.

is seeking an

Under the general direction of the Project Manager – Reports of Investigation (“ROI”) and the Utilities Senior Project Manager, the Utility Design Reviewer contributes alongside a team of Utility Design Reviewers to prepare, review, coordinate, and track all utility Reports of Investigation for the client.
The Utility Design Reviewer is responsible for preparing ROI reports in conformance with the Client’s Right-of-Way Manual for all irrigation, water, drainage, electric, gas, telecom, privately owned utilities, and railroad facilities impacted by the client’s high-speed rail system.

Recommendation on approvals on all utility determination packages submitted by the utility relocation staff.

A Healthier, Happier Me Foundation is seeking skilled volunteer support through Taproot Plus. Taproot Plus is an online platform that connects nonprofits to professionals seeking strong opportunities to volunteer their talent for good. https://ahhmfoundation.org/
About This Project
If you would like to learn more about this organization and project, please follow the apply link to schedule a preliminary call with a representative of the organization.
About This Organization
A Healthier, Happier Me (AHHM) Foundation is a 501(c)(3) organization that provides individuals from marginalized communities with the knowledge and resources needed to thrive physically and emotionally.
Website design - Website Redesign: Azure & WordPress
We seek a web designer to create structure and design options for our nonprofit website. We utilize WordPress and Azure for website hosting. The volunteer should assess and incorporate our goals and needs and consider our key audiences. The designer should also assess our technical capabilities. The project's deliverable is a draft of architecture and design concepts that we can easily share with a web developer volunteer or a member of our team who will use the guide to create our new site.
Our work will take place over multiple meetings in six to nine weeks. In our first meeting, the volunteer should interview us about our desired features, our web capabilities, and our technical expertise. Then, they'll synthesize the information into a requirements briefing. We'll engage in various check-ins, where a member or members of our team will provide feedback. The volunteer will audit our current site to create a draft of site architecture and design options, including wireframes, site structure, and other visual elements.
A nonprofit's website is extremely important not only for reaching the community we aim to serve but also for our donors (retainment and potential donors). We recognize the need to polish our website and believe this is significantly holding us back. With your help, we can create a professional, informative yet strategic, and easy-to-navigate website that would allow us to reach the targeted audiences. This is a highly visible project that will impact us for a long time!
We have already thought about and are prepared to brief you about our current website platform, budget restrictions for the build, our branding collaterals and norms, and information about our stakeholder groups and target audiences. We've also compiled some photos and have some language developed that we will share with you and samples of sites we like.
This project can be done remotely.

full_description:
Association for Pelvic Organ Prolapse Support is seeking skilled volunteer support through Taproot Plus. Taproot Plus is an online platform that connects nonprofits to professionals seeking strong opportunities to volunteer their talent for good. All Taproot Plus projects are vetted and once Association for Pelvic Organ Prolapse Support selects a volunteer applicant, Taproot Plus will provide resources and support to help make the project a success.
https://www.pelvicorganprolapsesupport.org/
About This Project
If you would like to learn more about this organization and project, please follow the apply link to schedule a preliminary call with a representative of the organization.
About This Organization
APOPS mission is to amplify pelvic organ prolapse awareness, to listen to and acknowledge patient voice, to destigmatize vaginal health, to encourage and optimize vaginal health empowerment, and to clarify and quantify POP quality of life ramifications.
Website design - Website Redesign: Squarespace
Seeking Squarespace web designer to refresh structure and design of APOPS website. The cause we champion remains shrouded and stigmatized. Our efforts to educate women are critical. Our site has multiple text-dense pages. Text info is critical, but we need a more visual platform to encourage those seeking help to capture it. Goals = engender awareness, support, and educate about pelvic organ prolapse for women teens through end-of-life.
Technical capabilities: no “team” behind the APOPS curtain. Founder juggling all balls, insufficient funding for payroll. I’m by no means a proficient techie (I make all website changes.) This project should be something I can easily comprehend and adapt to. I'm used to the Squarespace platform, but need guidance to get the ball rolling.
While we don’t have a set time deadline, book marketing and a women’s health expo have the potential to draw media and podcast/radio/television interviews to explore our space, so the sooner we can make the magic happen, the better. Hoping within 6-8 weeks, we’ll be ready to rock. I’ll dig into Squarespace options to build a base list of desired features. Designer synthesizing info to point direction w/b so helpful. Happy to provide feedback at predetermined intervals. A designer audit of our current site to create a draft of site architecture and design options including wireframes, site structure, and other visual elements would be priceless!
Published a new book in early November, marketing hard to eradicate the stigma that has shrouded pelvic organ prolapse in silence for nearly 4,000 years despite 50% prevalence. Anticipate considerable media exposure related to a marketing plan, and want the website to look updated, polished, targeted, compassionate, and compelling to make women exploring for support, practitioners exploring to understand our efforts, and media intrigued to get past the stigma of women's below the waist health.
Childbirth and menopause are the leading causes of POP, yet there is no standardized screening protocol in position. Women in our space ask daily "Why wasn't I informed of or screened for POP sooner?" APOPS is making every effort to engender pelvic organ prolapse awareness so women know about this condition ahead of the curve rather than post-diagnosis. But we also have much to address on the practice and policy sides of the equation. A solid website is critical to our efforts.
I am familiar with Squarespace since I built the website in 2010 and have been doing the updates since then. I will explore visual options this week to get design ideas I feel would be a good fit for our needs. Once completed, I will continue to do the updates since we have no staff at this point in time. Hoping media exposure to book and women's pelvic health expo in development will produce funding to enable staff for future needs.
This project can be done remotely.

full_description:
Association for Pelvic Organ Prolapse Support is seeking skilled volunteer support through Taproot Plus. Taproot Plus is an online platform that connects nonprofits to professionals seeking strong opportunities to volunteer their talent for good. All Taproot Plus projects are vetted and once Association for Pelvic Organ Prolapse Support selects a volunteer applicant, Taproot Plus will provide resources and support to help make the project a success.
https://www.pelvicorganprolapsesupport.org/
About This Project
If you would like to learn more about this organization and project, please follow the apply link to schedule a preliminary call with a representative of the organization.
About This Organization
APOPS mission is to amplify pelvic organ prolapse awareness, to listen to and acknowledge patient voice, to destigmatize vaginal health, to encourage and optimize vaginal health empowerment, and to clarify and quantify POP quality of life ramifications.
Website design - Website Redesign: Squarespace
Seeking Squarespace web designer to refresh structure and design of APOPS website. The cause we champion remains shrouded and stigmatized. Our efforts to educate women are critical. Our site has multiple text-dense pages. Text info is critical, but we need a more visual platform to encourage those seeking help to capture it. Goals = engender awareness, support, and educate about pelvic organ prolapse for women teens through end-of-life.
Technical capabilities: no “team” behind the APOPS curtain. Founder juggling all balls, insufficient funding for payroll. I’m by no means a proficient techie (I make all website changes.) This project should be something I can easily comprehend and adapt to. I'm used to the Squarespace platform, but need guidance to get the ball rolling.
While we don’t have a set time deadline, book marketing and a women’s health expo have the potential to draw media and podcast/radio/television interviews to explore our space, so the sooner we can make the magic happen, the better. Hoping within 6-8 weeks, we’ll be ready to rock. I’ll dig into Squarespace options to build a base list of desired features. Designer synthesizing info to point direction w/b so helpful. Happy to provide feedback at predetermined intervals. A designer audit of our current site to create a draft of site architecture and design options including wireframes, site structure, and other visual elements would be priceless!
Published a new book in early November, marketing hard to eradicate the stigma that has shrouded pelvic organ prolapse in silence for nearly 4,000 years despite 50% prevalence. Anticipate considerable media exposure related to a marketing plan, and want the website to look updated, polished, targeted, compassionate, and compelling to make women exploring for support, practitioners exploring to understand our efforts, and media intrigued to get past the stigma of women's below the waist health.
Childbirth and menopause are the leading causes of POP, yet there is no standardized screening protocol in position. Women in our space ask daily "Why wasn't I informed of or screened for POP sooner?" APOPS is making every effort to engender pelvic organ prolapse awareness so women know about this condition ahead of the curve rather than post-diagnosis. But we also have much to address on the practice and policy sides of the equation. A solid website is critical to our efforts.
I am familiar with Squarespace since I built the website in 2010 and have been doing the updates since then. I will explore visual options this week to get design ideas I feel would be a good fit for our needs. Once completed, I will continue to do the updates since we have no staff at this point in time. Hoping media exposure to book and women's pelvic health expo in development will produce funding to enable staff for future needs.
This project can be done remotely.
