full_description:
Who are we?
Thank you for asking! Kindness and curiosity are some of Atelier Ten’s core tenets.
We are a team of environmental and lighting designers championing for a healthier planet leveraging our vast, collective knowledge of sustainable spaces. We help bring beauty and efficiency to every building, because like Maybelline, not all buildings are “born with it.” We work with architects, engineers, owners, and other stakeholders to accomplish their sustainability, wellness, functionality, and visual goals. We don’t just follow the trends of the industry, we trailblaze new paths to create high performance, sustainable, and award-winning buildings.
What is this role on a high level?
Let’s take a moment to see the overview of the role before we get into the nitty gritty.
We want you to be Atelier Ten New York’s newest full-time Senior Environmental Designer. In this role you will consult on and manage projects, based on experience and capability, under the direction of an Associate and/or Director. In addition to managing awesome projects, you’ll be responsible for maintaining client and design community relationships, participating in meetings, supporting or leading charrettes, excellent written and verbal team communication, reporting, budgeting, and time management.
What Your Day-to-day Looks Like
Days at Atelier Ten are filled with a large variety of project types from offices, labs to large masterplans. We promise to keep you challenged and never bored. Here are some regular tasks you may encounter:
Independently and proactively project planning
Client management and communication
Design and contractor team coordination
Leading client presentations and team meetings
Partnering with Atelier Ten’s technical analysis teams to support your projects
Project fee forecasting and resource planning
Authoring and reviewing project deliverables such as reports, memos, and technical reports.
Creating graphic illustrations, drawing from our various technical practices
Work on multiple types of projects within the built environment ranging from institutional to commercial to residential building projects as well as large scale masterplans.
Collaborate with Atelier Ten’s integrated design groups to support the full range of our services, which include environmental design consulting, daylight and façade analysis, lighting design and benchmarking.
What We Are Looking For
Hopefully you’re on board so far and excited about what your days at Atelier will look like. We do have a few items on our wish list for you to become the next great Atelier Tenner. We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive, self-motivated with an appreciation and willingness to learn on multiple projects. And if we’re not pushing our luck with asks, you ideally will possess:
Bachelor’s or higher degree in a field related to environmental building design, architecture, architectural engineering, and/ or building science
5-10 years’ professional experience in an architecture or sustainability consulting firm
LEED AP with specialty certification preferred
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel and Word.
Experience with AutoCAD, Rhino or graphics software (Adobe Illustrator and InDesign) a plus
Effective time and budget management capability
Strong technical and business writing skills
Good verbal and inter-personal ability
What to expect from us?
Competitive salary
100% paid medical, dental, and vision benefits
Generous paid time off
Flexible / hybrid work schedule
Emphasis on work life balance
401k matching program
Highly engaged coworkers with a shared hunger for knowledge
Mutual respect and support from colleagues and leadership
Paid Life and Disability insurance
Paid parental leave
Paid volunteer time
Pre-tax commuter benefits
Annual professional development funds
Freedom to contribute ideas and make a personal difference that is not always possible in a large corporate environment
Really good high-fives
Atelier Ten US seeks to compensate staff based on a variety of factors related to the role and the candidate. These factors include (but not limited to) the responsibilities, requirements, and location of the position, as well as the candidate’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. We also consider internal equity, market data, and growth potential. The good faith estimate of the base compensation offered for this role is between $80,000 and $105,000. This range does not include the value of Atelier Ten’s many benefit offerings. The compensation range may vary if the candidate is hired to work remotely from a location not listed for this role.
How To Apply
Sadly, we no longer accept phone calls, award winning films, or interpretive dances as applications. But we will take the following:
A cover letter and resume in .pdf format to usa.recruitment@atelierten.com . (Reference “NY Senior Environmental Designer” in your subject line)
Visit our website at www.atelierten.com for additional firm information.

About This Organization
Avoidant Personality Research Center (Apcr) is a 501c3 nonprofit located in Meridian, Idaho. We focus on mental health and specifically a condition called Avoidant Personality (Avpd)
Avpd is a mental condition that includes Major Depression, Severe Social Anxiety, fear if people, fear of going outside, Extreme sensitivity to criticism, extreme sensitivity to Rejection and much more. See our web site for additional details and symptoms. Avoidants.org
As I am sure you are aware, mental disorders are running rampant in our society. To see evidence of this, all one has to do is watch the news The news is full of stories of mass killings, suicide, suicide by cop, school shootings and many other violent crimes.
Many of the people that carried out these atrocities were mentally ill and suffer from conditions like Avoidant Personality. These might have been able to be avoided if the perpetrators had received the help that they needed.
It is to this end that APRC wants to help. We are a small nonprofit with a very big vision. Our mission it to;
Research and gather data on Avoidant Personality
Raise Awareness of Avoidant Personality

Our mission is to teach and promote emotional intelligence through immersive technology and storytelling.

We seek a web designer to create structure and design options for our WordPress website. The volunteer should assess and incorporate our goals and needs and consider our key audiences. The volunteer will audit our current site to create a draft of site architecture and design options, including wireframes, site structure, and other visual elements.
We are at a growth phase that is not seen on our website. Wonderseed is looking to reach a wider audience to continue helping our youth across the nation. With your help, we will be able to help thousands of youth throughout our communities across the nation through possible donors who come across our website.
We have already thought about and are prepared to brief you about our current website platform, budget restrictions for the build, our branding collaterals and norms, and information about our stakeholder groups and target audiences.
